items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-07-01
items.q: Did you ever know Charlie Cook? Doc Cook? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, oh God yeah. Cook, that's the greatest musician.

ctx.x: Well, Mr. Seedman, Tony Jackson was a master there, same as he was here when they had to ride his in Chicago. For one. There was Dave Payton was another crackerjack piano player. And another, well he played at the Owl, what is his name again? He played at the Owl, that's a long second, he'll get his name in a few minutes. He was a crackerjack piano player.
Well let me ask you about somebody. Did you ever know Charlie Cook? Doc Cook?

Yeah, oh God yeah. Cook, that's the greatest musician. He's one of the greatest who was in the world. Cook was. Yeah, Cook he was, oh God. He was a top guy. He was a top guy. Cook could direct you know, and play as he direct you know. Cook was a crackerjack musician, Cook was. He was one of the best. Cook was. That was Cook, Charlie Cook, yeah he was the best.
